project_type: Python Streamlit web app - LinkedIn optimization engine using Google Gemini API
build_system: pip with requirements.txt, no Makefile or Dockerfile
test_framework: pytest with conftest.py providing fake session state and repo root on sys.path
verification_instructions: Run pytest tests/ - all tests must pass. Key test file: tests/test_voice.py validates voice constants.
setup_instructions: pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install pytest
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. No Docker available. Python 3.11 pre-installed.
contribution_requirements: Tests run via pytest. CI runs on Python 3.11. Tests must pass before merge.
key_patterns: Voice system in core/voice.py exports constants (HUMAN_VOICE_PRIMER, BANNED, HUMAN_SIGNATURES, STRUCTURE_RULES) composed into prompts. post_generator.py has build_post_prompt() that assembles these plus industry_profiles into a Gemini prompt. Output format uses ---VARIATION 1--- / ---VARIATION 2--- / ---ANALYSIS--- delimiters parsed by regex. core/polish.py uses same voice constants. core/validator.py parses BANNED phrases at import time via regex on quoted strings. Tests in test_voice.py assert key structural properties of voice constants.
directory_structure: Root: app.py (entry), post_generator.py, industry_profiles.py, gemini_client.py. core/: voice.py, polish.py, validator.py, sanitize.py, ai.py. tests/: test_voice.py, conftest.py.
